# Clawlege

> Free, open source interactive course teaching anyone to build AI agents with OpenClaw.

Clawlege is a completely free educational platform that teaches kids, teens, and adults how to build personal AI agents using the OpenClaw framework. No coding required to start.

## Course Structure

9 modules from beginner to advanced:

### Beginner (No Coding Required)
- Module 1: Meet Your Agent — Write your first agent personality in plain English using SOUL.md
- Module 2: Teaching Your Agent — Configure behavior with AGENTS.md, set up memory and preferences
- Module 3: Securing Your Agent — API key protection, prompt injection defense, permission boundaries, data privacy
- Module 4: Making It Yours — Advanced customization, voice, personality refinement

### Intermediate
- Module 5: Real-World Skills — Connect to web search, email, calendar, and other services
- Module 6: Build Something Unique — Design custom skills, solve real problems
- Module 7: Hardware & Senses — Voice assistants, cameras, wearables, IoT integration

### Advanced
- Module 8: Ship It — Package, share, deploy your agent for others
- Module 9: Demo Day — Present your work, build a portfolio, contribute to open source

## Starter Templates

5 ready-to-use OpenClaw agent workspaces:
- Personal Assistant (Atlas) — Daily briefings, reminders, calendar management
- Homework Helper (Sage) — Patient tutor that guides to answers, not gives them
- Sports Tracker — Live scores, standings, player stats
- Weather Buddy — Forecasts with outfit suggestions and activity recommendations
- Recipe Finder (Basil) — Meal planning, grocery lists, ingredient-based cooking

## Key Facts

- 100% free, no signup required
- Open source under MIT license
- Built on OpenClaw (openclaw.ai)
- GitHub: github.com/Clawlege/clawlege
- All modules and templates available at no cost
- First 3 modules require zero coding experience
- Full course takes approximately 8 hours
